_meta.description: Isolated Directus Flow definitions for VAMO Business Portal Verified Stripe Checkout & Charge Protection. DO NOT apply to production without explicit authorization.

flows.name: Stripe: Preview Subscription Checkout (Authoritative Invoice Preview)
flows.description: Validates promotion code eligibility against customer + priceId, creates a Stripe Invoice Preview (POST /v1/invoices/create_preview), and returns authoritative subtotal, discountAmount, tax, amountDueToday, renewalAmount, duration, and HMAC/signed verificationReference.

operations.name: Compute Stripe Invoice Preview & Verification Reference

flows.name: Stripe: Create Subscription (With Charge Protection & First-Invoice Verification)
flows.description: Upgraded Create Subscription flow. Verifies approvedAmountDue, approvedCurrency, promotionCodeId, and verificationReference before and after creating the Stripe subscription. Cancels incomplete subscription immediately if first invoice amount_due exceeds approvedAmountDue or if an approved promotion code failed to apply.

operations.name: Create Subscription & Enforce Approved Maximum Charge
